name: Hong Kong
about: Oct–Dec is comfortable and clear; summer is hot, humid and typhoon-prone; winter is mild and dry.
overview: Skyline, harbor, and street food — dense and endlessly walkable.
costOverview: A ferry ride or a milk tea costs almost nothing; dim sum and taxis add up faster than the skyline suggests.
